sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: They're physically stuck.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: They can't move it.
sentences.zh: 他们无法移动它。

sentences.en: They're trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 他们正在设法解决。

sentences.en: Finally, they just say, we can't do this.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们只能说，我们做不到。

sentences.en: We have to go to plan B.
sentences.zh: 我们必须执行备选方案。

sentences.en: And in this case, it means they're going to send three new planes, different planes, in to basically get the commando team as well as the downed airmen.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这意味着他们将派出三架新飞机，不同的飞机，基本上是为了接回突击队以及被击落的飞行员。

sentences.en: And so this means that the Americans have to buy themselves more time.
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国人必须为自己争取更多时间。

sentences.en: And what they do, until these new aircraft can arrive, is they basically create a ring of fire around this air base, where they're basically blasting away from high-altitude
sentences.zh: 在这些新飞机到达之前，他们所做的是在空军基地周围建立了一个火力圈，基本上由高空轰炸机进行扫射，

sentences.en: bombers, anybody that gets near it.
sentences.zh: 任何靠近的人都会被击中。

sentences.en: So the replacement planes finally arrive.
sentences.zh: 所以，替换的飞机终于到了。

sentences.en: They were able to load up the commandos, get the airmen on board, and off they go.
sentences.zh: 他们成功地装载了突击队员，让飞行员登机，然后离开了。

sentences.en: One, two, three in succession.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个，一共三架。

sentences.en: One plane takes off.
sentences.zh: 第一架飞机起飞。

sentences.en: In about 15 minutes, the next plane takes off.
sentences.zh: 大约15分钟后，下一架飞机起飞。

sentences.en: And finally, the third plane takes off.
sentences.zh: 最后，第三架飞机起飞。

sentences.en: The last thing they do, the military does, is they have to destroy these aircraft that they originally flew in on.
sentences.zh: 他们——军方——做的最后一件事，是必须摧毁他们最初飞来的那些飞机。

sentences.en: The ones that got stuck in the sand, the helicopters that came with them, because they've got all this sensitive technology on them that they don't want to fall into Iranian hands.
sentences.zh: 那些陷在沙子里的飞机，以及随它们而来的直升机，因为上面有他们不希望落入伊朗手中的敏感技术。

sentences.en: So this is kind of the irony of all this.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是这一切的讽刺之处。

sentences.en: At the end of the mission, they actually bombed the planes that were helping to rescue.
sentences.zh: 在任务结束时，他们实际上炸毁了参与救援的飞机。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But by now, the three aircraft are airborne, and they're on their way to Kuwait.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，这三架飞机已经升空，正在前往科威特的途中。

sentences.en: The airman is being treated aboard, and soon he and the pilot, who they've obviously been treating, will be on flights to Germany in a medical hospital there.
sentences.zh: 飞行员在机上接受治疗，很快他和他们一直在救治的飞行员将被送往德国的一家医院。

sentences.en: So the successful rescue gave President Trump a huge victory, which he touted at a Monday press conference at the White House.
sentences.zh: 这次成功的救援给了特朗普总统一个巨大的胜利，他在周一白宫的新闻发布会上大肆宣扬了这一点。

sentences.en: And we're here today to celebrate the success of one of the largest, most complex, most harrowing combat searches.
sentences.zh: 我们今天在这里庆祝军事史上规模最大、最复杂、最令人揪心的战斗搜救行动之一的成功。

sentences.en: I guess you would call it a search and rescue mission, ever attempted by the military.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以称之为搜救任务，这是军方有史以来尝试过的。

sentences.en: Where he praised the military, he praised the CIA.
sentences.zh: 他赞扬了军方，也赞扬了中央情报局。

sentences.en: So in a breathtaking show of skill and precision, lethality and force, America's military descended on the area.
sentences.zh: 在展现了令人惊叹的技巧、精确度、杀伤力和武力之后，美国军队降临该地区。

sentences.en: Talking about only the American military could have pulled off such an amazing rescue operation.
sentences.zh: 谈到只有美国军队才能完成如此惊人的救援行动。

sentences.en: Rescued the stranded officer, destroyed all threats, and exited Iranian territory while taking no casualties of any kind.
sentences.zh: 救出了被困军官，摧毁了所有威胁，并在没有造成任何伤亡的情况下撤出了伊朗领土。

sentences.en: But despite this, this still leaves a very unpopular war that's created all kinds of economic consequences around the world, and obviously in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，这仍然留下了一场非常不受欢迎的战争，它在世界各地，显然也包括在美国，造成了各种经济后果。

sentences.en: And it still leaves many of the president's strategic goals unfinished.
sentences.zh: 而且总统的许多战略目标仍然没有完成。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的Connections游戏，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky，我每天负责制作Spelling Bee和Letterboxd游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Eric, the United States and the Trump administration are obviously touting this rescue operation as a huge victory.
sentences.zh: 那么，Eric，美国和特朗普政府显然正在将这次救援行动吹捧为一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: How are the Iranians viewing it?
sentences.zh: 伊朗人是怎么看的？

sentences.en: Well, the Iranians are also touting it as a big victory for different reasons, of course.
sentences.zh: 嗯，伊朗人当然也出于不同的原因将其吹捧为一场大胜利。

sentences.en: They were successful in shooting down the first American combat plane.
sentences.zh: 他们成功击落了第一架美国战斗机。

sentences.en: No doubt about that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: They also basically demonstrate that the Americans don't fully control the airspace, as Secretary
sentences.zh: 他们也基本上证明了美国人并没有完全控制领空，正如Hegseth部长所谈到的那种空中优势，

sentences.en: Hegseth has talked about, this air dominance, that they are still able to launch ballistic missiles and drones.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然能够发射弹道导弹和无人机。

sentences.en: And in fact, some of our other reporting has indicated that the Iranians are still able to
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的一些其他报道表明，伊朗人仍然能够

sentences.en: fire off about 15 to 30 ballistic missiles every day, as well as 50 to 100 drones, one-way attack drones.
sentences.zh: 每天发射约15到30枚弹道导弹，以及50到100架单向攻击无人机。

sentences.en: So they still have significant capability, whether it's to fire at American warplanes or to fire at energy infrastructure around the neighboring Gulf countries.
sentences.zh: 所以他们仍然拥有强大的能力，无论是向美国战机开火，还是向邻近海湾国家的能源基础设施开火。

sentences.en: It's still a significant problem.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个重大问题。

sentences.en: And thus, it shows the Iranians still have some will to fight and some capability to fight.
sentences.zh: 因此，这表明伊朗人仍然有战斗的意志和战斗的能力。

sentences.en: Given all of that, what does it tell us about what the United States has actually accomplished in the war?
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，这告诉我们美国在战争中到底取得了什么成就？

sentences.en: Because right now, this is week six, and I bet that a lot of people had either assumed or understood that the United States had destroyed a lot of Iran's military capabilities
sentences.zh: 因为现在已经是第六周了，我敢说很多人要么认为，要么理解美国已经摧毁了伊朗的大部分军事能力，

sentences.en: that, as you've said, seem to be working to some extent.
sentences.zh: 而正如你所说，这些能力似乎在某种程度上仍然在发挥作用。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you've got a military campaign that, by many measurements, is actually succeeding.
sentences.zh: 所以你进行了一场从许多衡量标准来看实际上是成功的军事行动。

sentences.en: The United States military, along with Israel, has been able to destroy or degrade much of Iran's missile program, much, if not most, of its drone program, its Navy, and
sentences.zh: 美国军方与以色列一起，已经能够摧毁或削弱伊朗大部分的导弹计划，大部分（如果不是绝大部分）的无人机计划、海军和

sentences.en: its Air Force.
sentences.zh: 空军。

sentences.en: But two things can be true here.
sentences.zh: 但这里有两件事可以同时成立。

sentences.en: You can still have a resilient Iranian military that's able to pop off missiles and drone when
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以拥有一个有韧性的伊朗军队，能够在需要时发射导弹和无人机，

sentences.en: it wants, at the same time where the American military has badly degraded what the regime can do long term.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国军方已经严重削弱了该政权长期行动的能力。

sentences.en: But the political goals, the political and strategic goals, are not necessarily on track.
sentences.zh: 但政治目标，政治和战略目标，并不一定在轨道上。

sentences.en: The president has given contradictory explanations as to what his endgame really is here.
sentences.zh: 总统对他的最终目标到底是什么给出了相互矛盾的解释。

sentences.en: And at his news conference, even as he was touting the success of this rescue mission, he angrily
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，即使在吹捧这次救援任务的成功时，他也愤怒地

sentences.en: lashed out and threatened the Iranians to basically say the entire country can be taken out in one
sentences.zh: 抨击并威胁伊朗人，基本上说整个国家可以在一个

sentences.en: night, and that night might be tomorrow night, basically threatening to bomb bridges and power
sentences.zh: 晚上被消灭，而那个晚上可能是明天晚上，基本上威胁要炸毁桥梁和发电

sentences.en: plants and, you know, who knows what else, if they don't come to the bargaining table and have a resolution to this by sometime on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 厂，你知道，谁知道还有什么，如果他们不在周二晚上的某个时间之前来到谈判桌前并解决这个问题的话。

sentences.en: That is such an existential threat that he is making.
sentences.zh: 他发出的威胁真是太具有生存威胁性了。

sentences.en: I feel like this rescue mission, this victory that he just had, has almost emboldened him in some way, just listening to some of these threats.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这次救援任务，他刚刚取得的这场胜利，在某种程度上让他更加胆大妄为了，只要听听这些威胁就知道了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, it's, it's interesting because a lot of us thought that it would actually chase in him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，这很有趣，因为我们很多人认为这实际上会让他收敛。

sentences.en: It would kind of show him the risks of this kind of military operation when the, so much of the success of it hinged on the rescue or not of this one airman.
sentences.zh: 这会让他看到这种军事行动的风险，因为它的成功在很大程度上取决于这名飞行员是否获救。

sentences.en: But I think you're right, Rachel, that he has basically taken this and said, you know what, this amazing American military machine that I have, they can do just about anything.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你是对的，Rachel，他基本上利用了这一点并说，你知道吗，我拥有的这台令人惊叹的美国军事机器，他们几乎可以做任何事情。

sentences.en: And I'm going to take this rescue operation and I'm going to double down now, and I'm going
sentences.zh: 我要利用这次救援行动，现在我要加倍下注，我要

sentences.en: to increase the threats and use this bombing power that I have to go after this infrastructure that supports not just the military, but millions of civilians across this country.
sentences.zh: 增加威胁，并利用我拥有的这种轰炸力量去攻击那些不仅支持军队，而且支持全国数百万平民的基础设施。

sentences.en: These power plants, for instance, are used both by the military as well as just regular civilians.
sentences.zh: 例如，这些发电厂既被军方使用，也被普通平民使用。

sentences.en: And many legal experts say this would be unlawful.
sentences.zh: 许多法律专家表示这将是非法的。

sentences.en: This would be against international law to carry out these kind of strikes.
sentences.zh: 进行这种打击将违反国际法。

sentences.en: Before this plane went down, Eric, on Friday and this rescue mission happened, so much of the reporting on the war focused on whether there could be some kind of an off-ramp.
sentences.zh: Eric，在这架飞机周五坠毁和这次救援任务发生之前，关于这场战争的大部分报道都集中在是否可能存在某种退出机制。

sentences.en: And I wonder if both the United States and Iran are claiming victory right now after this rescue mission.
sentences.zh: 我想知道美国和伊朗在这次救援任务后是否都在声称胜利。

sentences.en: Isn't that some path to an off-ramp?
sentences.zh: 这难道不是通往退出机制的某种途径吗？

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: Certainly in listening to the president at the news conference, he is still at least saying he wants a diplomatic resolution to this.
sentences.zh: 当然，在听总统的新闻发布会时，他至少仍然表示他希望通过外交手段解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And in fact, Iran on Monday submitted a new 10-point proposal that included terms that would allow for some kind of protocol for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, but
sentences.zh: 事实上，伊朗周一提交了一份新的10点提案，其中包括允许某种通过霍尔木兹海峡安全通行协议的条款，但

sentences.en: it would also include the lifting of sanctions against Iran.
sentences.zh: 这也将包括解除对伊朗的制裁。

sentences.en: Now, the vice president, J.D.
sentences.zh: 现在，副总统J.D. Vance本周将前往欧洲，所以如果这些谈判取得进一步进展，他可能会参与会议。

sentences.en: Vance, is going to be traveling to Europe this week, so it's possible he could be involved in meetings if these negotiations were to get further along.
sentences.zh: 但这一切在很大程度上仍不清楚。

sentences.en: But much of this is still unclear.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈过的许多专家仍然认为谈判还遥遥无期。

sentences.en: And a lot of experts that we talk to still believe that negotiations are a long ways off.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在的处境是，总统设定了一个最后期限，截至目前是周二晚上，要求伊朗人要么投降并接受美国的

sentences.en: So where we stand right now is that the president has set a deadline, as of now it's Tuesday evening, for the Iranians to either capitulate and accept a U.S.
sentences.zh: 停火提议，要么面临对其基础设施的一连串攻击。

sentences.en: proposal for ceasefire or face a barrage of attacks on its infrastructure.
sentences.zh: Eric，我们应该如何思考这让我们处于冲突的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: How should we be thinking, Eric, about where that leaves us in terms of what stage of the conflict we are currently in?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为如果我们抱有希望的话，我们可以说也许我们正处于某种解决方案的边缘，双方都可以尝试从中争取一些东西。

sentences.en: Well, I think if we were to be hopeful, we could say maybe we're on the brink of some kind of resolution where both sides could try and claim something out of this.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们在其中一些关键问题上仍然相距甚远。

sentences.en: But I think we're still a long ways away on some of these key issues.
sentences.zh: 而且总统似乎正在朝着升级的方向前进，威胁要进行更多的轰炸，即使这需要几天或几周的时间。

sentences.en: And the president seems to be moving in the direction of escalation, of threatening more bombing, even if it takes days or weeks.
sentences.zh: 然而，伊朗政权认为他们现在掌握着主动权。

sentences.en: The Iranian regime, however, believes they're in the driver's seat right now.
sentences.zh: 他们通过继续控制霍尔木兹海峡拥有了筹码，那是他们如此迅速抓住的经济瓶颈。

sentences.en: They have the leverage by still holding on to the Strait of Hormuz, that economic bottleneck that they have grabbed so quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且通过能够击落一架美国战机，通过能够继续向该地区的能源基础设施开火，他们已经证明，即使他们的军事装备

sentences.en: And by being able to shoot down an American warplane, by able to continue to fire at energy infrastructure around the region, they've demonstrated that even though they're badly
sentences.zh: 严重退化，他们仍然可以时不时地反击。

sentences.en: degraded in terms of military equipment, they still can launch a punch every now and then.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为双方都在加强各自的立场，而在此时，至少公开的言论是试图寻找一个退出机制。

sentences.en: And so I think both sides are hardening their positions at a time when at least the public rhetoric is to try and find an off-ramp.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所描述的那样，这次救援行动简直就像电影一样。

sentences.en: This rescue operation, as we have described it, could not have been more cinematic.
sentences.zh: 而且，它发生的时候，政府真的在努力向美国公众兜售这场战争，

sentences.en: And also, it is coming at a time when the administration is really struggling, I think, to sell this war
sentences.zh: 他们看着加油站，看到价格不断上涨，想知道，我们为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: to an American public that is looking at the gas pump and seeing prices go up and up and up and wondering, why are we doing this?
sentences.zh: 所以感觉你不可能给白宫提供比这更好的叙事了，

sentences.en: And so it feels like you could not have handed the White House a better narrative than this
sentences.zh: 这个令人难以置信的英雄故事展示了美国的军事力量、独创性、勇敢，正如我们所说，这本可以是从电影中摘录出来的。

sentences.en: one, this unbelievably heroic story that shows American military might, ingenuity, bravery that, as we said, could have been ripped from a movie.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为白宫和五角大楼会试图尽可能长时间地利用这一点。

sentences.en: And I think the White House and the Pentagon are going to try and milk this for as long as they can.
sentences.zh: 这次行动的成功是电影般的，而美国飞行员的获救是戏剧性的。

sentences.en: The success of this operation is cinematic, and the rescue of an American airman are dramatic.
sentences.zh: 但最终，看看你还剩下什么。

sentences.en: But in the end, look at what you're left with.
sentences.zh: 你仍然面临霍尔木兹海峡关闭，到处都是经济困难。

sentences.en: You're still left with the Straits of Hormuz closed, economic hardship throughout.
sentences.zh: 你仍然面临一个认为自己正在获胜而不是失败的强硬政府。

sentences.en: You're still left with a hard-lying government that thinks it's winning, not losing.
sentences.zh: 而且你仍然面临这个根本问题，即如何处理埋在伊斯法罕基地深处的那近1000磅高浓缩铀？

sentences.en: And you're still left with this fundamental problem of how do you deal with this nearly
sentences.zh: 你该怎么处理那个？

sentences.en: 1,000 pounds of highly enriched uranium that's buried deep underneath the Isfahan site?
sentences.zh: 总统周一表示，这仍然是他的主要目标，即防止伊朗获得核武器。

sentences.en: And what do you do with that?
sentences.zh: 但他没有提出任何关于如何做到这一点的目标。

sentences.en: The president said on Monday that that is still his main goal, to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 所以即使总体上取得了军事成功，即使周五成功救出了这两名飞行员，政府仍然面临许多非常棘手的问题需要解决。

sentences.en: But he has not laid out any of the objectives on how you do that.
sentences.zh: Eric Schmidt，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: So even with the military success overall, and even with this very successful rescue of these two airmen on Friday, the administration is still left with a lot of really difficult
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: problems to address.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Eric Schmidt, thank you so much.
